user.title: Create Bitcoin portfolio
user.description: Bitcoin only. Ledger, depots, goals, and history are stored locally. Public historical prices are fetched only through the configured Tor proxy.

data.name: Portfolio name
data.encryption_enabled: Encrypt local ledger with a master password
data.history_tor_proxy: Bundled Tor SOCKS5 proxy for public data sources

kraken.title: Public market average via Tor
kraken.description: Live BTC prices are calculated as an arithmetic mean of independent public Kraken, Coinbase, Bitstamp, and CoinGecko quotes routed through Tor. Kraken remains available for historical candles.

mempool.title: mempool price API
mempool.description: Own mempool instance or public service. Own instances are queried first and remain preferred on overlap; older missing history may then be filled by the next configured source and Tor-routed public fallbacks. Onion addresses and public instances require Tor.

data.mempool_own_instance: This is my own mempool instance

entity.title: Existing Home Assistant price sensor
entity.description: The state must contain the numeric price of one BTC. Add an explicitly configured public-market-average or mempool source for the same currency to backfill historical values. Sources are tried in configuration order.

encryption_password.title: Choose master password
encryption_password.description: The password is used with Scrypt and AES-256-GCM and is never saved. After every Home Assistant restart each allowed user must unlock the portfolio again.

error.cannot_connect: The price source could not be reached or returned no BTC price.
error.unsupported_currency: At least one selected currency is not returned by this mempool API.
error.password_mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
error.weak_password: Use a master password with at least 16 characters.
error.invalid_tor_proxy: The Tor proxy must be a complete URL with host and port. The bundled default is socks5://20c000e9-bitcoin-stack-tracker-dashboard:9050.
error.invalid_mempool_route: Direct access is allowed only for an explicitly marked own non-onion instance. Public and onion addresses must use Tor.

add_sale.title: Add Bitcoin sale
add_sale.description: FIFO applies inside the selected depot. Mixed-currency matches remain unresolved until an FX conversion is available.

add_stack.title: Add BTC without cost basis
add_stack.description: This balance counts toward the stack but creates an unresolved FIFO portion when sold.

add_depot.title: Add depot
add_depot.description: Multiple depots create additional depot-specific sensors and long-term statistics.

add_goal.title: Add stacking goal
add_goal.description: Each additional goal creates {sensor_count} live sensors and additional long-term series. More goals increase recorder and statistics storage.

history_settings.title: Historical daily values
history_settings.description: Public historical price providers are fetched only through Tor, with no clearnet fallback. History uses an ordered source cascade: own infrastructure first, then configured sources, then Tor-routed public fallbacks only for still-missing older ranges.

add_source.title: Add price source
add_source.description: Sources are ordered by priority. The first reachable source supplies the live price; later sources can act as fallbacks or provide history for the same currency.

data.mempool_own_instance: This is my own mempool instance

export_csv.title: Export CSV and ZIP
export_csv.description: Persistent plaintext export is disabled. Use the dashboard download, which creates files only temporarily.

tax_settings.title: Holding-period and tax overview
tax_settings.description: The configurable holding period classifies FIFO lots as short- or long-term. This is an overview only, not tax advice and not a tax return.

edit_goal_details.title: Edit stacking goal
edit_goal_details.description: A goal creates {sensor_count} sensors. Name, BTC amount, depot, and fiat currency can be changed at any time.

error.invalid_amount: Amount, price, and goal must be greater than zero.
error.insufficient_stack: The selected depot did not contain enough BTC at that time.
error.duplicate_currency: This exact price source is already configured.
error.cannot_connect: The price source could not be reached or returned no BTC price.
error.unsupported_currency: At least one selected currency is not returned by this mempool API.
error.depot_not_empty: The depot contains ledger entries and cannot be deleted.
error.delete_breaks_fifo: Deleting this entry would leave a later sale without enough earlier BTC.
error.invalid_tor_proxy: The Tor proxy must be a complete URL with host and port. The bundled default is socks5://20c000e9-bitcoin-stack-tracker-dashboard:9050.
error.invalid_mempool_route: Direct access is allowed only for an explicitly marked own non-onion instance. Public and onion addresses must use Tor.

abort.last_source: The last price source cannot be deleted.
abort.no_depots_to_delete: There is no additional empty depot to delete.
abort.history_sync_failed: History synchronization failed. Details are available in the Home Assistant log and history sensor.
abort.not_loaded: The integration is not currently loaded.
abort.vault_locked_use_dashboard: The Bitcoin vault is locked. Unlock it in the Bitcoin Stack Tracker app first.

add_purchase.name: Add Bitcoin purchase
add_purchase.description: Add a BTC purchase with known fiat cost basis to the local ledger.

depot_id.name: Depot ID
depot_id.description: Target depot. The default depot is main.

price.name: Price per BTC
price.description: Actual fiat purchase price for one BTC.

currency.name: Currency
currency.description: Fiat currency code, for example EUR.

fee.name: Fee
fee.description: Purchase fee in the same fiat currency.

timestamp.name: Time
timestamp.description: Purchase date and time. Empty means now.

add_sale.name: Add Bitcoin sale
add_sale.description: Add a BTC sale. FIFO is calculated separately inside the selected depot.

depot_id.name: Depot ID
depot_id.description: Depot from which the BTC is sold.

price.name: Price per BTC
price.description: Actual fiat sale price for one BTC.

currency.name: Currency
currency.description: Fiat currency code, for example EUR.

fee.name: Fee
fee.description: Sale fee in the same fiat currency.

timestamp.name: Time
timestamp.description: Sale date and time. Empty means now.

add_stack.name: Add BTC without cost basis
add_stack.description: Add existing BTC without assigning a purchase price.

timestamp.name: Time
timestamp.description: Acquisition date and time. Empty means now.

add_depot.name: Add depot
add_depot.description: Add another locally stored depot and create depot-specific sensors.

add_goal.name: Add stacking goal
add_goal.description: Add a stacking goal with its own fiat currency. Each goal creates five sensors.

depot_id.name: Depot ID or all
depot_id.description: Apply the goal to one depot or to all depots.

currency.name: Fiat currency
currency.description: Currency for remaining amount and target value.

delete_entry.name: Delete ledger entry
delete_entry.description: Permanently delete one purchase, sale, or stack entry. Deletion is blocked if it would break FIFO.

ledger_entry_id.name: Ledger entry ID
ledger_entry_id.description: ID returned by the ledger export.

set_goal.name: Set first stacking goal
set_goal.description: Backward-compatible action that updates the first goal or creates it.

export_ledger.name: Export ledger as response
export_ledger.description: Return ledger, depot, goal, and FIFO data as action response data.

export_csv.name: Export CSV and ZIP
export_csv.description: Write transactions, FIFO matches, and holding-period overview as CSV/ZIP below /config.

delimiter.name: CSV delimiter
delimiter.description: Semicolon is usually best for German spreadsheet programs.

sync_history.name: Synchronize historical daily values
sync_history.description: Download daily BTC prices from explicitly configured sources, cache them locally, and import long-term statistics.

update_goal.name: Update stacking goal
update_goal.description: Change goal name, amount, depot, and fiat currency.

set_tax_settings.name: Set holding-period rule
set_tax_settings.description: Store a configurable long-term threshold and note. Overview only.

long_term_days.name: Tage
long_term_days.description: Days from acquisition until long-term classification.

dashboard_data.name: Dashboard data
dashboard_data.description: Internal dashboard action with local ledger and history.

set_history_settings.name: Set history settings
set_history_settings.description: Enable or disable historical daily values. Existing cached price data is retained.

delete_all_entries.name: Delete all entries
delete_all_entries.description: Permanently delete all local ledger entries.

update_entry.name: Update ledger entry
update_entry.description: Correct an existing ledger entry while keeping its ID. FIFO is validated before saving.

ledger_entry_id.name: Ledger entry ID
ledger_entry_id.description: ID of the existing ledger entry.
